statement:
Let \(a, b\) satisfy \(a \geq b > 0\) and \(a+b=1\).
i) Prove that if \(m < n\) are positive integers then \(a^m - a^n \geq b^m - b^n > 0\).
ii) For each positive integer \(n\), consider \(f_n(x) = x^2 - b^n x - a^n\). Show that \(f_n\) has two roots both in \((-1, 1)\).

\(L\) and \(M\) are parallel lines distance \(d\) apart. Construct triangle \(ABC\) with \(A\) on \(L\) and \(B, C\) on \(M\), with inradius \(r\) and \(\angle A = x\). Express angles \(B\) and \(C\) in terms of \(d, r, x\). If the incircle touches \(BC\) at \(D\), find the relation between \(BD\) and \(DC\).
